Commentary.Commentary: With more than 3 days left and a mammoth target of 413 set, a result is beyond doubt now. Sri Lanka are favorites to complete their series victory here unless a miracle happens. The Australians will have to face a tricky phase up to stumps today. Can the hosts nip out a wicket or two before close? We shall find out as the chase begins soon.

Sri Lanka adding another 94 runs after tea to swell their lead well past the 400-run mark. Dilruwan's half century and Herath's stubborn resistance were the highlights for the hosts as the pair added 61 runs for the 8th wicket. Starc claimed his second fifer of the game and ended with a 11-wicket match haul to wrap up the innings.

OUT! GONE FIRST BALL! Sixth scalp for Starc! Full and angled in from around off, tails away sharply as Fernando pokes at it. Gets an outside edge to first slip where Voges takes a very good low catch. 11 wickets in the match for Starc. What a performance by him on a track that has favored the spinners. SL HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 237. AUSTRALIA NEED 413 TO WIN.
VISHWA FERNANDO is the last man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! Second fifer in the game for Starc! Perfect yorker on off,  tailing in and Dilruwan fails to dig that one out as the ball rattles the timber. Ends a very good knock from Perera. It's a 10-wicket match haul for Starc. What a game he is having!
FOUR! EDGE GOES THROUGH! Full and angled in from outside off, Dilruwan pushes at it and gets a thick edge that gets between the slip cordon and gully to the third man fence.
UPDATE 1645 IST - As expected, it was a minor delay as the covers are off. The players and umpires are back on the field as well. We are ready to resume.
UPDATE 1640 IST - It's started to drizzle and the covers are coming on to the ground. It seems to be a passing shower though although it is a bit dark out there.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN is the new man in.

OUT! Loopy delivery around middle and leg, turns a bit. Herath tries to be fancy again and goes for the reverse sweep. He drags it back on to the stumps and departs! He made a handy contribution of 26 runs with the bat!
Similar delivery, Perera again goes for the sweep and strikes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Perera tries to sweep it but does not connect.
Perera dances down the track but decides to defend it.
SIX! Tossed up on middle, Perera gets down on one knee and strikes a meaty blow over the deep square leg boundary. That was timed to perfection!
Floated around leg, Herath sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Pitched up outside off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot towards mid on.
Length ball angled in from outside off, defended well from the crease.
Full and wide outside off, squeezed it out to deep backward point for a brace. THE LEAD IS NOW 400.
Another yorker closer to off, Dilruwan does well to keep it out.
Yorker on off, dug out nicely back to the bowler.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
Perera advances down the track and pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
50-run stand between Perera and Herath.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side for a single.
2nd Test fifty for D.Perera.

Tossed up ball on off, Perera strides forward to defend it but the ball takes the inside edge of his bat and rolls through square leg. They pick up a single. With that, it's 50 up for Perera. It's his second test fifty and really well deserved!
The batsman comes down the track and does well to get his body behind the ball.
Herath again pulls out the reverse sweep from his armoury and picks up a single this time. It seems that the reverse sweep is his go to shot.
Tossed up on middle, Herath brings out the reverse sweep and hits it down to third man for a couple!
Floats it down the leg side, Perera misses the flick due to the extra bounce.
Fuller outside off, Herath reaches out and stabs it to point for a single.
Flighted outside off, Herath goes for the big sweep but misses.
RIPPER! Loopy on a length from outside off, spins away sharply with extra bounce to square Herath up completely.
Drifting in on off, blocked out well to short leg.
Sliding in from middle and off, Herath blocks it out to the off side.
Full delivery, Perera lunges forward and pushes it to the covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball around off, Perera strides forward and pushes it to the point region.

Perera survives! Flighted delivery around off, Perera again dances down the track but there is extra spin on the ball and it fizzes off the pitch and beats Perera who tries to lift it. Nevill is sharp behind the stumps and dislodges the bails on the second attempt! There is a referral to the third umpire! The replays shows that Perera came back in just at the nick of time.
FOUR. Floated outside off, Perera dances down the track and lifts it straight over Holland's head and the ball races to the boundary!
FOUR. Floated around middle, Perera sits down on one knee and slog sweeps it over  mid-wicket for a boundary!
Gets forward this time and makes a watchful leave.
FOUR! Short on middle, Herath camps back and latches onto it with a half pull through mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase but fails to cut it off. He is having a lovely day out there.
Flighted ball around middle, Perera comes down the track and works it towards wide long on for a single.
Outside off, Rangi reverse sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Full and around middle, swept towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, Herath gets down to sweep it but misses as the ball goes just past his outside edge.
Full on middle, Perera leans forward and pushes it back towards the bowler.
A bit flatter around middle and leg this time, Perera steps down the track but fails to defend it and gets struck on the pads.
Floated around middle and leg, Perera strides forward and defends it.
Perera again charges down the track and drives it for a couple!
Tossed up around middle, Herath sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Perera steps down the wicket and hits it to the mid-wicket region.
HOLLAND into the attack!
Loopy ball around off, Herath defends it gently off the front foot.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Rangana has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
Full and around off, Herath looks to reverse sweep this time but misses and is hit on the pads.
Loopy ball around off, Perera reverse looks to play the reverse sweep but gets a top edge towards fine leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, Herath pushes at it towards backward point for a single.
Bouncer around off, Perera ducks under it and lets it go.
Almost a carbon copy of the previous delivery.
A length delivery around off, angling into the stumps. Perera covers the line well and defends with the full face of his bat.
A short delivery around off, Perera ducks under it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A fullish delivery around off, angling in. Perera strides forward and defends it solidly.
Leg bye! Floats it up outside off, Perera steps out to push at it as the ball goes off the pads to the off side. A leg bye taken.
Drifting away from outside off, Herath plays the reverse sweep that goes down to third man for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Drifting away from outside off, blocked off the back foot to cover.
Drifting in on a length on off, Herath gets back to block as the ball lobs off the thigh pad to short leg.
Flighted on middle and off, defended solidly off the front foot to cover.
Drinks break......
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bouncer around off! Perera ducks under it. It was too high to trouble him.
Short of a length delivery outside off, angling in. Perera goes back and guides it towards the covers.
Full delivery around middle, tailing in. Perera covers the line well and drives it down to mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line. The batsman plays at it and gets beaten.
Angled in from round the stumps, Herath flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Perera steps out and bunts it back at Lyon. Almost a return catch but the ball just falls short of the bowler.
Floats it up on off, turns in sharply to rap Dilruwan on the pads as he misses the sweep. Big appeal for lbw but that was easily missing leg.
Full outside off, Herath reverse sweeps it down to third man for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, Herath looks to flick as Nevill takes it nicely. Big appeal for caught behind but turned down.

IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Drifting in from outside off, Dilruwan uses his feet to heave it away but miscues it high to deep mid-wicket where Khawaja doesn't react quickly enough as the ball falls safe. Single taken.
Flighted outside off, Perera steps out to block and is hit on the body.
Shortish delivery around middle, angling away, Herath opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a couple.
Length ball around middle, Herath stays back and defends it.
Pitched on middle, drifting away. Herath lets that one go.
Good length delivery around middle, Herath guides it towards the gully region.
A fullish delivery outside leg stump, tailing in. Herath glances it down to fine leg for a couple!
A fullish delivery around leg stump, Herath comes forward and blocks it.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD back into the attack!
Drifting in from outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Loopy outside off, Perera uses his feet and blocks it out.

NOT OUT! Floats it up around off, too full as Perera goes for the sweep but is struck on the pads. Loud, loud lbw appeal but turned down by the umpire. Smith decides to review it. The impact might be the area of concern  as there doesn't seem to be any inside edge on it. What does Hawk Eye have to say? Impact is umpire's call and that is the end of that then. It would have been missing the stumps anyway and so Australia have lost both their reviews.
Australia have reviewed an lbw decision against Dilruwan Perera.
Drifting in from outside off, Herath reverse sweeps it to third man for a couple.
Floats it up on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floats it up outside off, Dilruwan steps out to heave it but gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
NATHAN LYON is back on.
Full delivery outside off, Herath covers the line well and blocks it into the ground.
Floated outside off, Herath reverse sweeps it down to short third man for a single.
Loopy delivery, Herath gets down on one knee and plays the sweep shot. Joe Burns turns back and the ball hits him on the hips. Oops! That must have hurt. He is taking quite a few blows at short leg.
Full floated up delivery, Perera strides forward and drives it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! A short delivery on middle, asking for trouble. Perera stands talls in his crease and pulls it effortlessly through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Floated around middle, dips in nicely. Herath reverse sweeps it behind covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, steered off the back foot to gully.
Good length outside off, angling in, Dilruwan pushes at it but is beaten.
Yorker on off, Herath just manages to dig out to cover for a single.
Fuller outside off,  Herath gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Good length outside off, pushed to the covers with soft hands. Perera wanted the single but is sent back in time as the throw misses at the bowler's end.
Outside off, Herath opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A high full toss again. Herath pulls it straight to Joe Burns at short leg who takes evasive action and the ball rolls on to the ground after hitting him on the legs.
Floated around middle, Herath gets forward and defends it.
Tossed up delivery, Herath pulls out a fancy reverse sweep but fails to execute it. The balls hits him on the chest. There is a strong appeal from the Aussies but in vain!

High full toss on leg stump, Perera lifts it over mid-wicket for a single. Lyon who is stationed at deep mid-wicket covers good ground and keeps the ball just inside the boundary. Good effort from Lyon!
HERATH SURVIVES! Top yorker on off, tails in a touch as Rangana just about jams it on to the track. In the process, the ball almost went on to hit the stumps but the veteran managed to stop the ball.
Length ball outside off, steered to point for a single.
Good length outside off, Dilruwan gets back and blocks it out.
Fuller outside off, Herath gets an inside edge on to the pads as the ball goes to the off side.
Fuller around off, dug out towards short cover.
Good length angled in from well down the leg side, Herath misses the flick as Nevill takes it well to his right.
Flighted around off, Perera pushes it to the covers.
Herath has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.

Flighted delivery around off, Herath lunges forward but fails to defend and the ball hits him on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire shows no interest! The impact was just outside the off stump.
Full toss on off stump, Perera drives it through mid-wicket for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
A leg spinner around off, turns away sharply. Perera goes for a cut but gets beaten.
Steve Smith into the attack!
RANGANA HERATH is the new man in.

OUT! STARC HAS ANOTHER! It's been a fantastic game for the pacer! Length ball slanting in from outside off, extra bounce and a bit of away movement as de Silva gets a nick through to Nevill. Ninth wicket in the match for Starc.
Dug in short on off, de Silva ducks under it.
Length ball angled in from outside off, de Silva pushes it towards mid on.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
FOUR! SHOT! Fullish on off, angled in as de Silva leans forward to drive it sweetly past mid on as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary.
Fullish outside off, driven off the front foot to the covers.
Fuller around off, Perera strides forward and defends it to the covers.
Loopy delivery outside off, Perera watches it go through to the keeper.
Tossed up delivery, Perera charges down the wicket and hits it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Holland. Tossed up, Perera converts  it into a full toss and lifts it over mid on. The ball races to the boundary!
FOUR! Tossed up around middle and leg, Perera gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller outside off, de Silva pushes it towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Good length on off, blocked well off the back foot.
FOUR! PULLED AWAY! Dug in short on middle and leg, pulled away superbly through backward square leg to find the fence. Cracking stroke although that isn't the length to bowl on this track.
Length ball on off, blocked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Good length on leg stump, de Silva plays across the line to flick but is hit high on the pads.
It shall be MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Perera rocks on to the back foot and puches it through covers. The fielder in the covers fumbles and it goes through his legs and reaches the boundary!
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Tossed up delivery, Perera dances down the track and heaves it aerially over covers for a couple. de Silva and Perera have made their intentions clear and are going after the bowlers!
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, de Silva dances down the wicket and lifts it over mid on for a superb boundary!
Floated around middle and leg, de Silva runs it down to fine leg for a couple.

Welcome back for the final session. Covers were on during the break more as a precaution as it had gone overcast across the ground. The conditions seem to be still murky but no rain as the players and umpires walk out to the ground. JON HOLLAND to start proceedings after tea.
......DAY 2, SESSION 3......

Australia's spinners continued to disappoint on a track where they were supposed to do the bulk of the wicket taking duties. It was left to the pacers to put pressure and Starc once again was exceptional with a fine burst after tea that included the important scalp of Chandimal. On a deteriorating track, this lead seems to be a match-winning one already but the Lankans would want to pile on the runs. Join us in a while for the final session.

A good session for Sri Lanka once again as they have taken a firm grip on this Test. Mathews and K.Perera were the main contributors with a brisk stand that put pressure on the Aussie bowlers. The tourists did pick up 3 wickets but conceded 112 runs as well which is of huge significance considering the massive first innings deficit they have. The lead is already 318 and the Lankan tail will hope to further swell the lead after the break.
Fuller outside off, Dilruwan reaches out and defends it well. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 2.
Drifting in on a length outside off, blocks it off the back foot to the off side.
A bit short outside off, de Silva stays back and slaps it past the covers for a single.
Loopy on a length outside off, jabbed off the back foot past cover for a single.
RIPPER! Loopy leg break outside off, spins sharply away as Dilruwan is beaten on the poke.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
STEVEN SMITH comes on to bowl.
Perera comes forward to a loopy delivery and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Perera comes forward and blocks it into the ground.
Loopy ball around off, Perera comes forward and defends.
Tossed up ball on off, Perera defends it off the back foot.
Flighted delivery down the leg side, Perera goes for the sweep and top edges it towards fine leg. The batsmen come back for a couple!
FOUR! SHOT! Too short from Lyon though as de Silva feasts on the width with a fierce cut through point. Another boundary to the total. The lead is now 313.
Flatter outside off, de Silva goes back to cut it away and gets a slice down to third man for a brace.
Fuller outside off, blocked out off the front foot.
Drifting in from around off, Dilruwan steps out and drives it down the ground to long on for a single.
Floats up the off break outside off, spins in sharply to rap Perera on the pads. Muted lbw appeal but turned down.
SIX! SHOT! THAT'S BEEN HAMMERED! Floats it up around off, Perera steps out to that one and launches it over long on for a big maximum. Terrific hit!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Fullish delivery around middle, shaping in. Perera gets squared up and edges it towards covers from the outside half of his bat. The batsmen complete a quick single. With that, the lead for Sri Lanka reaches 300 runs.
Full delivery outside off. Perera has a go at that one but gets beaten. That was a loose shot!
Fullish delivery around off, Perera drives it uppishly and it falls just short of the fielder at covers.
A back of a length delivery around middle and leg. Perera goes back and pushes it to the cover region.
Full length delivery on off, Perera gets forward and defends it.

THAT WAS VERY CLOSE! Floats it up on off, de Silva goes for the sweep and gets it on the glove. The ball goes towards leg slip where Smith had come in all the way from first slip with good anticipation but couldn't take it even after a fine dive. Great effort though from the Aussie captain. The ball goes to the deep and a brace is taken.
Full and outside off, Perera leans into it and whips it away through mid-wicket for a single.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the new man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Floats it up on leg, Mathews tries the fancy reverse sweep but misses as the ball goes through to hit the stumps. The SL skipper misses out on a fifty but has played a valuable knock. The lead is now 296.
Floats it down the leg side, Mathews goes across to flick but misses.
Drifting away outside off, Mathews hangs back and blocks it out.
Flatter on leg stump, Mathews goes back to flick but is hit on the pads.
Fullish delivery outside off, shapes away a bit. de Silva plays at it but gets beaten convincingly.
Bouncer around leg. bangs it in and the ball takes off from the pitch. de Silva ducks under it and lets it go to the keeper.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full again, shaping in. Mathews guides it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish around off, shaping in. Mathews goes back and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A juicy full toss on off stump, Mathews drills it down the ground. The ball hits the stumps on the non striker's end and still has enough pace to go past the boundary down the wicket.
Floats it up on outside off, spins in sharply as de Silva hangs back to block it out.
Slider outside off, defended firmly off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, blocked out off the front foot.
Drifting in on a length on off, blocked off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Floats it up on middle and leg, spins in sharply to get a bat pad. The ball lobs up and goes through the vacant leg slip region to the deep.
Short delivery outside off. Mathews tries to pull it but misses the ball completely. That was a pretty casual shot!
Back of a length around leg stump, gets a bit of extra bounce. Mathews goes back and defends it unconvincingly.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
On a good length around off, Mathews flicks it uppishly but it falls just short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length around off, skids off the pitch and hits Mathews on the glove. Another example of the crumbling nature of the pitch!
Good length delivery around off, Mathews defends it off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, Mathews goes back for the cut and gets a slice down to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, de Silva leans forward and pushes it to long on for a single.
Fuller on off, Mathews leans into it and works it away to the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
FOUR! THAT WAS CLOSE! Loopy on a length on off, de Silva goes for the pull and gets a bottom edge down the leg side to the fine leg boundary. That went just past the leg stump.
Flatter on a length outside off, whipped off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
NATHAN LYON comes back on.
A full toss on leg stump. de Silva drives it straight back to silly mid on and fails to capitalize on the loose delivery!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Almost a replication of the previous delivery.
Around middle, Mathews pushes it down to mid on.
Full length delivery around off and middle, shaping in a bit. Mathews flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full length delivery wide outside off, Mathews has a go at it but just manages to put a little bat on that one and the ball rolls towards the cover region.
MITCHELL MARSH comes on to bowl.
Length ball slanting in from just outside off, goes through with the angle as de Silva lets it pass.
Pitched up closer to off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
Fine delivery! Length ball angled in from just outside off, tails away a touch as de Silva is beaten on the poke.
Fuller outside off, de Silva drives it sweetly to deep cover for a brace.
Length ball angled in from outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Very full on middle and leg, dug out towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish around off, de Silva comes forward and blocks it into the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around middle, shaping in. de Silva defends it solidly from within the crease.
Fullish delivery around middle and leg, Mathews flicks it well through mid-wicket this time.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
Fullish delivery around middle, tailing in. Mathews looks to flick it away but gets a slight edge from the outer half of the bat and the ball rolls on to the pitch.
Good length outside off, blocked well towards short cover.
Full and straight on off, dug out towards the bowler.

Fuller and on leg stump, worked through mid-wicket as the ball goes to the deep. They take the brace and also the third as Holland fires a very tame throw from the deep. A better throw might have made things interesting.
Full and wide outside off, driven to deep point for a single.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is the new man in.

OUT! STARC THE MAN AGAIN! Length ball angled in from outside off, straightens a bit after pitching with subtle away movement. Chandimal lazily wafts at it and gets a thin edge through to Nevill who takes it with ease. There was a bit of extra bounce on it as well. SL have lost half their side now with the lead on 273.
Full and on off, driven off the front foot to mid on.
Drinks break.....
Around off, Mathews blocks it from within the crease.
Length ball around off, Mathews defends it straight back to the bowler.
Yorker around middle and leg, Mathews is alert to it and digs it out well.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews goes back and defends it solidly.
Length ball around off, The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Wide! Short delivery around off, zips through the pitch. Mathews looks to play a pull but the ball is too high and Nevill has to jump to grab the ball above his head. That was the first wide of the series!
Good length delivery around off, Mathews goes back and flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
Good length fired well down the leg side, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! STREAKY BUT SAFE! Full and angled in from outside off, Chandimal drives without any footwork and gets a thick edge. The ball flies between the two slips and gully to the third man fence.
Short of a length wider outside off, Chandimal chases it but is beaten.
FOUR! LOOSE FROM STARC! Full toss well outside off, easy for Chandimal who doesn't miss out. Times the cover drive well to find the boundary.
Fullish on off, Chandimal drives and gets it off the inside half towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, angled in as Mathews clips it down to fine leg for a single.
MITCHELL STARC comes back on.
Full and outside off, Chandimal tries to drive it through the covers but instead gets an inside edge which rolls back down to the bowler.
Fullish delivery outside off, Chandimal strides forward and defends it solidly.
Good length delivery outside off, Chandimal steps down a little and defends it to the leg side.
Fullish delivery around off, shaping in. Chandimal shuffles accross to negotiate the swing and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery outside off, Chandimal goes back and blocks it into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, Chandimal shuffles accross and drives it confidently to mid off.
Some nice flight given here by Nathan Lyon, it's slightly shorter in length as well, The Lankan skipper stays within his crease and keeps it out off his back foot.
Swept down to short fine leg for a brisk single. Nicely placed and well run too.
Going down leg this time, Chandimal here goes for the sweep shot. Misses as the ball goes off his gloves. Falls short of the keeper and misses the leg stump as well.
Full on middle and off, Angelo gets low to this and sweeps it to backward square leg for one run.
Tossed up on the stumps, Mathews sweeps this one hard. Burns feels the burn on his buttocks as the ball hits him hard there. Rubs it off like a brave little lad.
Slowing it up here Lyon, flights it well on off, Mathews steps out of his crease to get to the pitch of the delivery, gets an inside edge which thuds off his pads.
Similar delivery, Chandimal is alert to it, rocks back and guides it nicely behind of deep square leg for a couple.

Back of a length delivery around middle, angling in. Chandimal is stuck on the crease and the ball hits him on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but in vain! The ball would have gone down the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish around off, angling in. Mathews covers the line well and drives it to mid off. The ball is reversing now!
On a good length outside off, Chandimal watches it carefully and leaves it.
Full delivery outside off, shaping in. Chandimal drives it to the cover region. Sweet timing on that one!
Another sweep shot to deep backward square leg for a single. Fitting shot to end the over, consistent. Good stuff.

Floats this one up on off, Chandimal gets down to sweep this and connects well, unfortunately for him the ball catches the leg of the man at short leg. It rolls over towards short fine leg as no run is taken.
Fullish around off, Mathews sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Another full delivery from Lyon, aimed at the stumps, Chandimal gets down on his rear knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg. Takes a single as he crosses over to the other end.
Yorker outside off, Dinesh digs this one out back towards the bowler.
Full and darted on off, gets down to sweep it straight to short fine leg.
Similar delivery around off, Mathews lunges forward and drives it to mid off.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews blocks it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery outside off, shaping in a little. Mathews strides forward and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Mathews goes back and defends it comfortably.
Outside off, driven towards the mid off region by Mathews.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD is back into the attack!
This time Dinesh connects the sweep shot but finds the fielder at short fine leg. End of the over.

Lyon floats this one up outside off, Chandimal kneels down to sweep this away. It goes off his pads and into Steven Smith's hands at first slip. He appeals as he feels there was some bat on that as well. The umpire isn't interested though.
Nicely tossed up just outside off, Chandimal is struck on the pads as he prods forward to block it out.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the next batsman in.

OUT! PERERA IS OUT OF HERE! And that's an excellent delivery. Lyon comes from around the wicket, bowls a slider, shorter in length. Perera doesn't pick it up as he rocks back to chop it away. Misses and the ball goes on to rock the timber. Fourth wicket down for Sri Lanka as the Aussies keep persisting. The Lankans now lead by 254 runs.
Short and outside off, it's punched to backward point off the back foot.
Floats it on a length outside off, too wide as Perera cuts it towards point.
Perera shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Perera brings out the sweep shot and uses it to good effect. The ball goes towards the square leg boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Short around off, Mathews goes back and  guides it thorugh covers for a single.
Flighted outside off, Mathews strides forward and drives it to the covers.
Tossed up on off, Mathews defends it from the crease.
ADAM VOGES comes on to bowl.
Drifting in on a length around off, Perera makes room and glides it down to third man for a brace. THE LEAD IS NOW 250.
Floats it up on off, Mathews works it away to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! POOR BOWLING! Drops it short down the leg side, Mathews gets back and clips it away down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller on middle and off, Mathews leans into it and defends it well.
Fired down the leg side, another sweep attempted that gets a top edge that goes to the same area as the previous ball. Single taken.
Flatter outside off, Perera goes for the sweep and gets a top edge through the vacant short fine leg region. A brace taken.
Tossed up around middle, Mathews pushes it to the cover region.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Around off and middle, Perera dances down the wicket and drills it over mid on for a couple. Warner who is stationed at long on makes a brilliant save.
Quicker around leg stump, Perera plays it down to short fine leg.
Outside off, Mathews playes it to the covers for a single.
FOUR! Full toss on middle, Mathews flicks it well through mid-wicket for a superb boundary! A lot of bottom hand on that shot!
Fuller on off, Perera steps out and pushes it to mid-wicket for a brace.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked away off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting away outside off, Mathews tries the reverse sweep again but gets it off the bottom of the bat. Smith at first slip anticipates well and moves to his right early to make the stop.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Floats it outside off, Mathews goes across to flick but is hit on the pads. Big appeal by Smith but Lyon wasn't interested. Clearly missing off.
Floats it up outside off, Mathews brings out the reverse sweep and gets it to third man for a brace.
Outside off, Perera goes back and punches it down to mid off.
Almost a carbon copy of the previous delivery.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Shorter around leg stump, Perera leaves it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up around middle, Perera steps down the wicket and drives it to mid on.
Sliding in short outside off, Perera sits back to cut as the slice goes down to third man. The fielder does well to make the stop but the batsmen get three.
Flatter outside off, cut away to the off side.
Floats it up outside off, Perera goes for the reverse sweep but misses.
Flatter outside off, Perera steps out and pads up to that one.
Flighted on off, Mathews sweeps it away down to fine leg for a single.
Flatter on off, swept away down to fine leg for a single.
Sliding in on off, defended well off the front foot on to the track.
Fuller on middle and leg, soft hands from Mathews as he clips it through mid-wicket for a brace. Good running!
FOUR! TOO SHORT AND PUNISHED! Dragged short outside off, Mathews goes back for the cut and slices it through backward point for a boundary.
Loopy outside off, Mathews steps out to that one and blocks it well.
Drifting in from outside off, Mathews gets the sweep very fine down the leg side to the deep for a brace.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Floats it up outside off, Mathews goes inside out with a lofted drive over the covers as the ball races to the fence. Intent straightaway from the SL captain.
The debutant JON HOLLAND comes on for the first time in this innings.
Floats it on a length on off, Perera was shaping for the cut but adjusts well to open the bat face very late to glide it towards third man for  a brace.
Slider on leg stump, Perera is rapped on the pads but that was going down leg.
Flatter outside off, Mathews walks across and paddles it down to fine leg for a brace.
Loopy on off, Perera sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flighted on off, Perera gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Flatter on middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Welcome back for the afternoon session. It will be Kusal Perera and Angelo Mathews will continue from where they left off. NATHAN LYON will start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's play..
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Australia are already on the back foot but have managed to fight back well in the second innings by taking those three early wickets. Sri Lanka have already stretched the lead to 206 runs on a crumbling pitch. Have Sri Lanka already drawn the curtains on the Aussies or is there still a twist in the tale? Do join us for the post lunch session which promises to be an enticing one!

It has been a session full of intensity and drama! Herath and Perera were outstanding with their venomous spin bowling and grabbed four wickets each. Australia got bundled out for a paltry score of 106 and conceded a crucial lead of 175 runs to Sri Lanka.

NOT OUT! Good length angled in from around off, comes in with the angle sharply as Mathews is hit on the pads. Two noises as Australia go for the lbw appeal but is turned down. Smith decides to gamble with the review. Was there an inside edge? Replays don't seem to suggest it but perhaps too high. Impact is definitely in line. Let's see what Hawk Eye has to say. Just clipping leg stump and so that means the umpire's call will stay. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Australia have taken a review for lbw against Mathews.
Full and angling in from outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Starc switches to round the wicket for the last 2 balls before lunch.
Back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Angelo defends it to the off side.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
ANGELO MATHEWS is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! STARC HAS HIS MAN! Good length just outside off, angled away with a bit of late away movement as Mendis is squared up a bit. Almost a replica of his first innings dismissal as the nick is pouched by Nevill safely. Australia making early inroads here but the lead is also swelling for the hosts.
Mendis flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated up outside off, holds its line. Mendis plays at it but gets beaten. That was a peach of a delivery!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They pick up a single.
Perera steps out and pads it away.
Floated around middle and leg, holds its line and strikes Perera low on the pads. The ball would have gone down the leg side as there was a lot of drift in the ball!
Short and outside off, cut away through point for a single.

FOUR! FLASHY BUT EFFECTIVE! SL are attacking and rightly so! Short and outside off, Perera slashes at it and gets a thick slice over backward point as the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary. The big first innings lead means that the hosts can afford to play fearlessly even if wickets are falling. Lead is past 200 now.

DROPPED BY VOGES! Sharp chance but should have been taken! Good length outside off, angling away with bounce as Mendis is squared up a bit on the push. The edge flies to first slip where Voges tries to take it in front of his eyes but spills the chance. Single taken.
FOUR! SMEARED! Full toss outside off, Mendis leans into it and smacks it through the covers to find the fence. Poor ball from Starc.
Fuller outside off, Mendis drives it off the front foot towards cover.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Perera opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a couple of runs.
SIX!Length delivery around off, straigthens a bit! Perera dances down the track and strikes a meaty blow over long on for a six! That was a risky shot by Perera but it paid off in the end!
Tossed up on middle, Mendis sweeps it well to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle, drifting in, strikes Mendis on the pads.
Shortish delivery, Perera goes back and square cuts it for a single.
Floated around middle, Perera comes down the track and blocks it into the ground.
Nathan Lyon comes into the attack!
Good length outside off, Mendis defends it off the back foot.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Full and wide outside off, Mendis tries to dig it out but misses as it goes through to the keeper. Muted appeal but the sound was of bat hitting the ground.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! STARC STRIKES! Poor batting from Karunaratne! Length ball outside off, a bit of extra bounce as Dimuth pushes weakly at that one. Gets a thick edge that flies to gully where Marsh takes an easy catch. Once again the Lankan openers have departed cheaply.
FOUR! CLIPPED AWAY! Fuller on middle and leg, Dimuth goes across and clips it away through backward square leg to find the fence. Nicely timed shot by the southpaw.
KUSAL PERERA walks out to bat.

OUT! THAT'S A GOOD CATCH BY SMITH! Fullish delivery outside off, holds its line. Silva pokes at it and gets an outside edge which flies off towards the second slip. Smith who is stationed there eyes it to perfection, dives to his left and takes a well judged low catch! That's the first blow for Sri Lanka!

Played to the point region by the batsman.
Length delivery, Karunaratne goes for a flick but inside edges it on to his pads.
Around off, angling in. Karunaratne flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Around off, Silva leans forward and pushes it to the covers.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to share the new ball.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Full delivery around leg, drifting towards the legs. Karunaratne flicks it handsomely through square leg for a couple.
